title: Remove Duplicates
objective: Keep each distinct value once in a sorted input array; return k. Only nums[0..k-1] is the sorted unique result.
constraints: 0 <= n <= 100000; sorted 32-bit integers; target: 1 second; O(1) extra space
callToAction: Comment the returned length and unique prefix.

narration.hook: Keep each value once in this sorted array. Return the unique count.
narration.setup: Read pointer R checks values. Write pointer W marks the next unique slot.
narration.zero: This value matches the last kept value. Advance only read pointer R.
narration.swap: Keep {value}. Swap it forward, then advance both pointers.
narration.summary: Compare against the last kept value, not the previous read slot. Return write pointer W.
narration.challenge: What unique prefix and length should this array return?
